Definition: properly, to prick or penetrate; hence, to blister (as smarting or eating into)
BiblicalUsage: Kavah means to burn, to scorch, to be branded by fire. Proverbs 6:28 asks, can one go upon hot coals, and his feet not be burned, and Isaiah 43:2 promises that when thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe fire tests everyone, but God's promise is that his people walk through it unburned.
